The '''Rogue Moon Project Command''' was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in a warehouse purchased by [[Zayne Carrick]]. It served as the base of operations for the [[Rogue Moon Project]], an organization supposed to help refugees and wrongly accused fugitives like Carrick himself used to be.
